segments.contextAfter: `samplePredicates`: A dictionary whose keys are [`HKSampleType`](hksampletype.md) instances, and whose values are [`NSPredicate`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Foundation/NSPredicate) instances. The query iterates over all the samples in the correlation. For each sample, it looks up the corresponding predicate based on the sample’s type and then evaluates that predicate against the sample. If the dictionary does not contain a matching sample type, the query treats it as a `nil` predicate, and accepts the sample. Three things must be true if this query is going to match a correlation: - The correlation object must match the provided predicate parameter.
